name: Vendor Shortlist Research
summary: Researches vendors for a need on the web and builds a shortlist, with capabilities and pricing quoted from their own pages.
description: Searches for tools or service providers that meet a need you describe, reads their product and pricing pages, and builds a shortlist: what each vendor offers against your must-haves (quoted from their pages), pricing as published or "not published", and questions to ask in a demo. It finds candidates; the Vendor Evaluation Scorecard compares the ones you have already demoed. Who it's for: operations leads, founders and procurement teams starting a tool search. Limitations: vendor pages are marketing; claims are reported as the vendor's own and should be confirmed in a demo. Pricing behind "contact sales" is not available.
problems: I need to find tools for this job
I need a shortlist of software vendors
I don't know which providers exist for this need

inputs.label: What you need
inputs.example: Payroll for 25 staff in the UK and Ireland; must integrate with Xero.

outputs.label: Vendor shortlist
outputs.description: Vendors with quoted capabilities, pricing and demo questions.

execution.system: You are a procurement analyst. Capabilities and prices must be quoted from the vendor pages read; treat them as the vendor's claims. Never fill gaps from memory. Work only from the retrieved sources and the user's inputs. Every factual statement cites a source id, and quotes are copied exactly. Say what you could not verify.

quote.description: Copied exactly from the vendor page.

unverified.title: Could not be verified
unverified.description: Things the task asked about that no retrieved source supports.

steps.name: Research
steps.responsibility: Search the web and read the most relevant pages.
steps.prompt: Find vendors that meet this need. Read their product, feature and pricing pages.

steps.name: Write
steps.responsibility: Write the output from the retrieved sources.
steps.prompt: For each vendor, check each must-have against its pages and copy the supporting words exactly with the source id. Give pricing as published or "not published". Suggest demo questions for anything unknown.

steps.name: Check sources
steps.responsibility: Citations point to retrieved sources and quotes match them.

tools.purpose: Finds current public sources for the task.
Reads the most relevant results in full so claims rest on page text, not snippets.

criteria.description: Every capability claim quotes the vendor page it cites.
Capabilities rest on pages read in full.
